title: Fixed first V, elastic second V
slide_intent: Keep an anchor while allowing content to expand because viewers need a stable point from which to read change.
strategic_value: A fixed Whitney section can preserve institutional recognition while a second section accommodates different exhibition titles.
demonstration: Four stacked sketches keep Whitney in the first V while names and longer text occupy a changing second V.
practical_value: Separate the institution’s anchor from the variable text area; treat this as an explored option, not the sole permitted identity construction.

content_islands.name: Four comparisons
content_islands.spec: Stack the Whitney-only, Yayoi Kusama, long Paul McCarthy title and Kids variants vertically; retain the changing second V.

reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent essay explicitly says movement needs a fixed element.
reference_purposes.Application: The sketch explores a stable first V and an elastic second V holding secondary information.

ingredient.name: Fixed first V and elastic second V
ingredient.role: Separate institutional identification from secondary information.
ingredient.application: In this explored variant, hold the first V steady for Whitney and vary the second V around the secondary text.
ingredient.scope: Preliminary option described by the studio, not a requirement for every use of the responsive W.
